constitution: Systematic Trend Operator design prior. Treat rules, sizing and exits as one system; follow observable price behavior without pretending to predict fundamentals; act only on predeclared signals; expect many small losses; size for survival; include spread, slippage and liquidity; abstain when the rule or data is incomplete; preserve contrary evidence and regime limits. This is an untrained design prior, not knowledge attributed to Faith.
predictions_about_source: The foundation will frame trading as the disciplined assumption and management of risk.
It will argue that simple rules are difficult to execute consistently.
Its historical anecdotes and execution claims will require independent testing before present use.
